يبتاعون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَاعُونَ (yabtāʕūna) /jab.taː.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
# يُبْتَاعُونَ (yubtāʕūna) /jub.taː.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
